title: Chinese Journal of UFO Research tacitly endorsed by CCP

tellings.quote: The Chinese have what they call the journal of UFO Research, which is a published periodical in the People's Republic of China.

plain: China publishes a periodical called the Journal of UFO Research, and its existence is taken as a sign that the Chinese Communist Party quietly approves of the subject. David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who has testified to Congress about secret UFO programs, mentions it to Michels as something he knows of second-hand, suggesting that China treats UFOs more openly than the US does.
